newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes hits new highs ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes hits new highs ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Finnish cranemaker KCI Konecranes Oy rose sharply in early trade to a new high on Friday on mostly foreign demand ahead of its January-August results due on Sept 26, brokers said.
At 1230/0930 GMT, Konecranes stood at 131.0, up 5.90 markka or 4.72 percent, in volume thin at less than one million markka.
"I quess it is speculative demand ahead of the result," one broker said. "Buyers may end up disappointed," said another.
Most of the action in Konecranes was coming from the banks that arranged Konecranes' share issue, one broker said.

U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch and Swedish Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken were joint lead managers of Konecranes' initial public offering in March of 5.76 million shares to international institutional investors and 1.44 million to Finnish investors.
The two banks also arranged another Konecranes offering of 3.65 million shares in June.
According to the central share register, 82.4 percent of Konecranes was owned overseas at end-August.
